name: plan-in-slack
about: Planning scenario 2 through #plan (docs/phases/07-planning.md, "Slack"): the approver's top-level message starts P1 ("high priority" and "in demo" read as in #loop) and the bot answers in the thread with the plan's header and a Drop button. The product turn runs (⏳ on the message, ✅ once the reply is posted) and its reply carries Approve brief v1. A reply in the thread queues the next turn, which writes brief v2. Pressing Approve brief v2 echoes with Cancel and applies after the 2-minute window, bound to v2's sha256; the engineering turn's blueprint (3 pieces, 2 and 3 depending on 1) gets Approve blueprint v1, and its approval lists the 3 filed items in the thread. Only piece 1 is claimable. /loop plans lists the plan while it is open.

steps.text:
A pantry list in demo, high priority
So I know what to buy before I shop.
